watches.name: Gravitas All Black Steel
watches.description: The Gravitas All Black Steel is a men's automatic watch built around one principle: a skeleton dial automatic watch should show you everything, not just tell you the time. The full open-dial craft puts 33 jewels, the gear train, and the oscillating balance wheel on permanent display — no battery, no closed face, nothing hidden. Most skeleton dial watches for men in India at this price use closed or partially open dials. The Gravitas uses a full skeleton design, finished in all-black with the movement components catching just enough light to remind you that something extraordinary is running underneath. The octagonal matte black alloy steel case and 5-link integrated bracelet form one unbroken line from lug to lug — a design detail typically found on watches priced many times higher. No battery. No charging. Just a mechanical watch that keeps working as long as you do." The Automatic Movement — 33 Jewels, No Battery Inside the Gravitas sits an automatic calibre with 33 jewels — synthetic rubies placed at high-friction pivot points to reduce wear and maintain accuracy over years of use. The rotor, a weighted half-circle visible through the skeleton dial, spins with the natural movement of your wrist and continuously winds the mainspring. Energy from the mainspring releases in a controlled sequence through the gear train to the hands. No battery. No charging point. This automatic watch for men runs as long as it's worn. After sitting unworn for roughly 40 hours, the crown winds it back to full power in a few turns. The continuous sweep of the seconds hand — unlike the tick of a quartz — is the unmistakable signature of a mechanical automatic calibre. The Skeleton Dial — Full Movement Visible A skeleton dial removes the solid dial face entirely. What remains is the movement frame, the bridges, the gear train, the balance wheel oscillating at its own frequency, and 33 jewels embedded into the movement — visible, identifiable, real. The Gravitas All Black takes the skeleton design further than most watches at this price: the dial is dark, the hour markers luminous, and the exhibition case back exposes the full movement from the reverse as well. New dial colour tones in the All Black variant add depth to the dark base. The jewels — deep purple-red against the all-black surround — stand out without competing for attention. Luminous tips on the hands ensure legibility in low light. The Octagonal Case — Geometry Borrowed From Luxury Eight sides. Eight corner screws. The octagonal case shape is a design language historically associated with luxury sports watches — Royal Oak, Nautilus, Ingenieur — where angular geometry replaced the traditional round case to signal something different. The Gravitas All Black borrows this geometry without the accompanying price. Fully finished in matte black with a brushed texture that absorbs rather than reflects light, the case sits solid on the wrist without bulk. The case back is stainless steel. The Integrated Black Bracelet — One Continuous Form The 5-link integrated stainless steel bracelet is finished in matte black and designed to sit flush where bracelet meets case — no visible gap, no mismatch in tone or texture. An integrated bracelet is engineered as part of the case design rather than added as a separate component; the result is a watch that wears as one continuous object from lug to lug. The deployant clasp opens and closes with a solid click. Link removal for sizing is done with a standard strap tool. Water Resistance — 3 ATM 3 ATM water resistance covers rain, splashes, and hand-washing without concern. It does not cover swimming, showering, or submersion. Keep perfumes, creams, and cleaning chemicals away from the case surface — these degrade rubber seals over time, even on water-resistant watches. They bring in a thin layer of sophistication to the dial but do not overwhelm the general design language of the dial. Strap & Wearing Comfort Both durability and style are increased by the Stainless steel Strap . It fits safely on the forearm even as it fits comfortably throughout the day. The smooth finished case is a perfect match to the glossy finish and it all looksributes to a coherent and high-end model. Such balance makes the Blade Dual Time an appropriate style of Office wear , traveling and social events that forms a stable option in a range of high quality men watches. Movement & Experience The Blade Dual Time is a model with a robust two-time engine providing a user up to date with an easy to use digital interface to the analogue movement. It is a hands-on experience that is reassuring, be it in keeping time, Stopwatch , or just scheduling on a day to day basis. Its digital controls and chronographic timing feature make it a good selection of the Chronographic watches which are supposed to be used in real life but not displayed.
